alternative_explanations: Any apparent gain may be ordinary stable feature selection, switching autoregression, predictive-state estimation, or event-triggered Kalman filtering rather than a successor principle.
confounds: Stable channel identity within each episode and a closed synthetic regime set may make routing substantially easier than open-world continuous inputs.
falsification_criteria: Kill the learned event route if it is inexact, unsafe under changed valid regimes, or matched or dominated by an implementable screened switching-AR or variance-triggered Kalman control at the same forecast accuracy once channel scan, trigger, fit, state, forecast, update, and total workload are counted.

outcome_policy.negative: If the event route fails changed-regime forecasting or safety while classical controls succeed, strengthen HYP-0012 modestly and discard this implementation family.
outcome_policy.null: If classical switching or variance-triggered controls match or dominate capability and full cost, retain HYP-0012 and make this event route dormant without tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: Treat an accurate non-dominated event route as counterevidence to HYP-0012 in this continuous family and allocate exactly one adversarial multi-seed screen.

predicted_outcome: Screened and exhaustive switching AR, variance-triggered Kalman, the event-predictive route, and the oracle should meet the accuracy threshold. Dense linear and echo-state controls may degrade under held-out regime order and confusable background. The event route is expected to collapse into classical regime detection plus local state and gain no unique capability or cost advantage once channel-side detection, fit, update, forecast, and workload are fully counted, supporting HYP-0012.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. The event route earns exactly one three-seed adversarial screen only if it has matched multi-horizon accuracy, exact changed-regime behavior, retention, no unsafe reuse, is non-dominated, and has a materially better full-workload K signature and local update cost than every implementable classical control.
research_question: Can a learned event-triggered predictive state identify a stable low-dimensional sufficient state from noisy multichannel continuous streams and preserve matched multi-horizon forecast accuracy with lower full-system K scaling and local update cost than dense linear state-space, echo-state, exhaustive/screened switching AR, and variance-triggered Kalman controls?
title: Continuous event-triggered predictive state under hidden switching dynamics
